contentItem.title: 球的直径
contentItem.englishTitle: A diameter of the sphere is any straight line drawn through the centre and terminated in both directions by the surface of the sphere.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A diameter of the sphere is any straight line drawn through the centre and terminated in both directions by the surface of the sphere.
球体直径是指通过中心并按球体表面向两侧截断的任何直线。（相关点与线段：A）
